context:
Deliverables:
1. A replayable baseline in `_project/analysis/` (script plus manifest of run IDs and window), following the pattern of `replay_ci_waste_remeasure.py`, reproducing every number above.
2. A decision record in `_project/decisions/` that states the exact moved job set, the carve-outs, the umbrella rule, the local preflight addition, the rollback trigger, and what it supersedes.

Required design constraints the record must adopt or explicitly reject with a reason:
- Carve-outs keep the full heavy tier on pull_request runs when the PR touches soundness paths (union of base-ref and PR copies of `_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py`, as `auto-merge-on-open.yml` does) or when `packaging-needed` is true.
- `ci-required-result` checks both directions: when the heavy tier is needed it must succeed; when not needed it must be `skipped`; any other result fails. `merge_group` always needs it for code-routed trees.
- Required check names, ruleset 15611785, and queue parameters do not change.
- Slow-marked promoted reproducers stay inside `code-test` on pull_request runs, preserving the recorded rule that they remain required PR CI (`required-ci-coverage-deepest-reproducers`, `native-merge-queue-activation-20260822.md` section 2.0, `docs/operations/merge-queue-governance.md`).
- Local `make pr-preflight` gains the medium tier for code-routed diffs (it would have caught 10 of the 11 historical failures).
- Rollback trigger by attribution: 3 or more merge_group failures of moved jobs in any 7-day window restores pull_request execution the same day.

Reconcile and name every affected record: merge-queue-governance.md section 2 table and slow-reproducer note, the pr.yml comment promising pre-merge macOS/Windows TPC-H framing, `certification_kind` semantics consumed by `develop-refresh-shadow.yml`, and `docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md`.

Decision gate: exactly one outcome, recorded in the decision record by the maintainer in a user message: APPROVE, APPROVE_WITH_CHANGES (changes listed), or REJECT (reason recorded; ci-dedupe-05/06/07 are then dropped with that reason). An agent must not self-approve.
description:
Decide whether pull_request runs of `pr.yml` stop running the heavy tier (medium-test, correctness-gate, plan-capture-gate, tpch-binary-framing, postgres/datafusion/clickhouse integration samples), leaving it to `merge_group` runs, which already run it on the exact tree that lands.

Evidence (2026-08-23 to 2026-09-16, Actions jobs API):
- pull_request runs of pr.yml used 45,562 runner-minutes; the heavy tier used 29,281 of them (64%): medium 13,058, correctness 10,344, tpch framing 2,063, postgres 1,361, datafusion 895, clickhouse 877, plan-capture 683.
- Across 750 pull_request runs the heavy tier failed in 11 runs on 8 PRs (medium-test 10, correctness-gate 2; the rest 0). Every one was fixed before merge. Two of those PRs were dependency upgrades (pandas 3, sqlglot).
- Across 318 merge_group runs the heavy tier failed 0 times.
- Superseded pushes cancelled 217 medium-test and 179 correctness-gate runs mid-flight.
- Job p50: medium-test 21.2 min, correctness-gate 15.8, code-test 13.5 (p90 22.5). Removing the heavy tier moves typical PR feedback from ~21 to ~14 minutes.

This item produces a decision record and a recorded human decision only. It edits no workflow.
